name: Horde Presence
summary: At the Barrens border, Kadrak sends a Horde champion into Stonetalon Peak after a missive is intercepted. The champion is to kill the dryad Rynthariel and plant a Horde banner inside the Talon Den.

sections.title: A Message Intercepted
sections.body: Kadrak watches the Barrens' northern boundary for Alliance and night elf incursions. After a messenger carrying a runed scroll is cut down, he decodes the missive and traces it to Rynthariel the Keymaster, an influential dryad in Stonetalon Peak. Kadrak chooses to strike rather than simply guard the mountain passes, hoping to deter future scouts from probing Horde territory.

sections.title: Defiance in the Den
sections.body: Horde warriors enter the Talon Den, a cavern overlooking Stonetalon Peak. Killing Rynthariel deals a blow to local night elf coordination. Kadrak's banner is planted inside the cave, its red standard marking the heart of dryad territory with a warning: incursions into the Barrens will meet decisive violence.

faq.q: Who is Kadrak and why does he order this strike?
faq.answer: Kadrak is an orc warrior stationed at the northern border outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale. He orders the strike after discovering Alliance messengers slipping through nearby passes, and seeks to secure Horde lands against foreign encroachment.

Rynthariel is a dryad leader in the Talon Den atop Stonetalon Peak. She wrote the runed scroll carried by the intercepted messenger, coordinating Alliance and sentinel movements through the mountain corridors.

faq.q: Where is the Talon Den located?
faq.answer: The Talon Den is a subterranean cavern complex on the western slopes of Stonetalon Peak, high in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is the purpose of planting Kadrak's flag?
faq.answer: Kadrak plants the flag as a warning. He wants the night elves and the Alliance to see the red Horde banner over their fallen leader and hesitate before sending more scouts through the Barrens.

faq.q: How does this quest connect to 'The Runed Scroll'?
faq.answer: Horde Presence follows The Runed Scroll. The mission begins after a player finds the intercepted parchment on an Alliance messenger and brings it to Kadrak for translation.

faq.q: Why is the Horde concerned about Alliance runners in the Barrens?
faq.answer: The Barrens links Orgrimmar, Thunder Bluff, and surrounding settlements. Alliance messengers and night elf allies traveling freely through mountain gaps threaten Horde supply lines and border security.

angles.text: For the Horde, securing the Barrens' northern border helps hold Kalimdor's central plains and protect its fledgling settlements from night elf incursions.
As a Horde druid, you face the bitter pull between faction allegiance and sacred ties to nature when you march into Stonetalon Peak to strike down a dryad child of Cenarius.
As an orc, you can see Kadrak's offensive as a show of strength and an answer to territorial intrusion, leaving the Alliance no room to maneuver.
